subject: The AXDescription of the plug-in window's Controls/editor AXMenuButton in French, Portuguese and Korean, against the two Apple rows whose English is View
question: Is the plug-in window's View switcher described by MAToolKit's `view` row, the value pluginWindowViewSwitcher now carries, rather than by the menu bar's `View#mti` row it was derived from on 2026-09-16?

reverify.expected: with a release build of a head that carries this change, the pluginWindowControlsViewMenuItem set_param_verified row reads `set` in fr, pt and ko, and neither fr nor pt answers plugin_view_switch_phase switcher_locale_unmeasured
reverify.cost: needs LPM_LIVE_LOCK naming an existing lock file the caller holds, LPM_EVIDENCE_ROOT exported as an absolute path outside the repository, and a running Logic with the lpm-locale-campaign fixture; it changes Logic's language once per locale and switches back to Korean at the end. The harness does not record the switcher's AXDescription; reading it again needs a watcher beside the run like the one the evidence file describes

method: live_904_labelsets_in_every_locale.py ran against a release binary built at e4e5edbe, before this change, in fr, pt and ko, switching Logic's AppleLanguages and reopening the lpm-locale-campaign fixture for each. Its set_param_verified compressor limiter_on call opens a Compressor window on a new audio track. Beside it a read-only watcher polled Logic's windows other than the project's and appended each new (window title, AXMenuButton AXDescription) pair. Each description was compared, as written, with the value `Scripts/logic_canon.py resolve` returns for MAToolKit's `view` row and for Logic.framework's `View#mti` row in that language.

observations.what: each plug-in window's AXMenuButton description the watcher recorded, with the two rows' values in that language
set_param_verified compressor limiter_on through the binary built at e4e5edbe, in this run
the same call in the ten-language run before it, same binary; no watcher ran

conclusion: In French the plug-in window's View switcher was described as 'affichage' and in Portuguese as 'visualização', MAToolKit's `view` values in those languages; neither is the menu bar's 'Présentation' or 'Visualizar', which pluginWindowViewSwitcher carried, and through that set the binary answered switcher_locale_unmeasured in both. In Korean it was '보기', which both rows carry, and the call reached `set`. pluginWindowViewSwitcher now carries MAToolKit's `view` row.
limits: The binary that ran is the one before this change. The value this record supports is the policy's, not a product result: set_param_verified reaching `set` in fr and pt through the fixed binary has not been measured.
host.locale is ko-KR because the host was in Korean before and after the run; each row names the language it was read in.
One run per language, one host, one plug-in (Compressor), one window each. This is not a rate.
The watcher writes a line per distinct (window title, description) pair, so one line per window says one description was seen there, not that the window had one AXMenuButton.
The watcher is not in the repository and the harness does not record the description; the evidence file carries the watcher's lines verbatim with its script's and output's sha256.

In the ten-language run de, en, es, it, ja, ko, zh_CN and zh_TW reached `set` for this call, which needs the switcher to match; zh_CN and zh_TW then answered param_control_not_found. No watcher ran then, so their descriptions were not recorded; in those languages the set's values rest on Apple's row, not on a reading.

The harness reported evidence_clean false for this run. Recomputed from its evidence.json: 3 of 3 checks passed, with 0 captures and 0 visual assertions under a declared ui surface. This record rests on the watcher lines and the reply excerpts, not on that verdict.

View, Visualización and Vista stay as members because `.exact` compares with caseInsensitiveCompare and they equal this row's view, visualización and vista up to case; no English, Spanish or Italian description was read in this run.

the pt-BR value of MAToolKit's view row, which the pt-BR plug-in window's View switcher carried as its AXDescription
the ko-KR value of MAToolKit's view row, which the ko-KR plug-in window's View switcher carried as its AXDescription
